summary: This Privacy Policy explains how PongTrace processes information, the purposes and legal grounds for processing, retention and deletion, disclosures, security measures, and the choices and rights available to you. It applies to the current iOS version of PongTrace.

ui.flowTitle: Built around on-device processing and your control

highlights.label: Commercial tracking
highlights.value: No ads · No analytics · No tracking

flow.title: You choose the input
flow.body: Camera frames, recordings, and media selected through system pickers are processed only when you use the related feature.

flow.title: Analysis stays on device
flow.body: Pose detection, movement metrics, smart clips, and comparisons run locally on your iPhone and are not uploaded to a developer server.

flow.title: You control the output
flow.body: Results stay in the app sandbox unless you explicitly save, export, or share them.

sections.title: Current privacy practices
sections.body: The current version does not require an account and does not use a developer-operated server. It contains no advertising, analytics, or tracking SDKs. PongTrace does not upload your videos, pose data, or app activity.

sections.title: Operator and data controller
sections.body: PongTrace is provided by an independent developer. The developer is the data controller only for personal information received directly, such as a support email. Videos, pose results, projects, and settings kept solely on your device are not received by or accessible to the developer.

sections.title: Information processed
sections.body: With your permission or selection, PongTrace processes camera frames; recorded or imported videos; body pose landmarks; movement metrics; rally segments; comparison results; exported clips; and app settings. This information is used only to provide recording, analysis, smart clipping, action comparison, playback, export, and preference features.

sections.title: Purposes and legal bases
sections.body: Core features process media locally at your request to provide the functionality you choose. Because this on-device content is not sent to the developer, it is not collected by the developer. If you contact the developer, your contact details and message are processed as needed to answer your request, provide support, protect legal claims, or comply with law. Depending on the context, the legal basis is performance of your request, the developer’s legitimate interests, compliance with a legal obligation, or your consent. Where processing relies on consent, you may withdraw it at any time for future processing.

sections.title: On-device analysis
sections.body: Pose detection, smart clipping, and action comparison run on your device. MediaPipe Tasks Vision is used as an on-device pose-processing component. PongTrace does not implement a network path that sends your videos or pose results to MediaPipe, Google, the developer, or an analytics service.

sections.title: Permissions and selected media
sections.body: Camera access is requested only for live pose detection and recording. Videos are imported from Photos and Files through Apple’s system pickers, so you choose what to import. Add-only Photos access is requested only when saving a result under your Save to Photos setting or an explicit save action. You can change permissions in iOS Settings.

sections.title: Local storage, retention, and deletion
sections.body: Training recordings, pose samples, comparison projects, exported clips, and preferences are stored in the app’s sandbox on your device. They remain until you delete them using available app controls or delete the app. Copies saved to Photos, Files, or another service must be deleted from that destination separately. The app may create temporary working copies while importing or processing video.

sections.title: Data security
sections.body: PongTrace limits processing through on-device operation, the iOS app sandbox, Apple permission controls, and data minimisation. No storage or transmission method is completely secure. You are responsible for protecting your device passcode, backups, and copies exported outside the app. If the developer receives support correspondence, reasonable measures are used to restrict access and retain it only as needed.

sections.title: User-directed sharing and support
sections.body: PongTrace sends content outside the app only when you choose to save to Photos, export, use the share sheet, or contact the developer. A destination app or service handles the information under its own privacy terms. If you email the developer, your email address and message are used to respond to your request and retained only as reasonably needed for support, dispute resolution, or legal obligations.

sections.title: Third-party services and international transfers
sections.body: MediaPipe Tasks Vision is integrated for on-device pose processing; this integration does not send your media or pose results to Google. Apple system pickers, Photos, Files, and the share sheet operate under Apple’s and the selected destination’s terms. PongTrace does not sell or rent personal information, and the current version does not initiate an international transfer of your on-device content. Information you voluntarily send through email or another service may be processed in locations used by that service under its own policy.

sections.title: Advertising and analytics
sections.body: The current version contains no advertising, analytics, or tracking SDK. Before any future version integrates Google AdMob or another data-collecting service, this policy and the App Store privacy disclosures will be updated to identify the relevant data categories, purposes, and recipients. Where legally required, consent and a way to change or withdraw privacy choices will be provided before advertising processing begins.

sections.title: Children’s privacy
sections.body: PongTrace is a general-purpose sports utility and is not designed to solicit personal information from children. The current version has no account, advertising, tracking, or online collection flow. A minor should use the app with parent or guardian involvement where required. If a parent or guardian believes a child has sent personal information to the developer, contact the developer to request deletion.

sections.title: Privacy choices and legal rights
sections.body: You can decline or revoke permissions in iOS Settings, delete content using available app controls, or delete the app to remove its sandboxed data. Depending on applicable law, you may request access, correction, deletion, restriction, objection, or portability for personal information controlled by the developer, withdraw consent, and lodge a complaint with a competent data protection authority. Because the developer does not receive your on-device data, you manage that data directly on your device. Email the developer about information received directly; reasonable identity verification may be required before a request is fulfilled.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.body: This policy may be updated when features, legal requirements, or data practices change. A revised policy will carry a new effective date. Material changes will be communicated in an appropriate manner before or when they take effect, such as in the app, release notes, or the published policy page. Previous versions will be retained where reasonably practical for reference.

contact.title: Developer and privacy contact
contact.body: The independent developer of PongTrace is the privacy contact and, for personal information received directly, the data controller. Use the email below for privacy questions or requests. Reasonable identity verification may be required before a request is fulfilled.

websiteHosting.title: Hosting of this privacy page
websiteHosting.body: This page is delivered through GitHub Pages. When you visit it, GitHub may process your IP address and necessary technical logs to deliver and secure the site and prevent abuse. GitHub is responsible for that processing under its own privacy statement; it is separate from PongTrace’s on-device processing. This page uses no developer-installed analytics, advertising, cookie banner, or tracker.
